name: OpenMM/CUDA, ff14SB + TIP3P, HMR 4 fs, 300 K
notes: MD protocol for a solvated flavoenzyme: ff14SB + TIP3P with hydrogen-mass repartitioning, 4 fs timestep at 300 K. For a target with a nucleotide cofactor (ATP/ADP/Mg) use md_charmm36m_2fs_310k instead -- ff14SB has no native templates for those residues.
literature: Eastman et al. 2017 (OpenMM 7); Maier et al. 2015 (ff14SB).
